dex.entry: A mote of the Skyweave itself given semi-sapient form — a thread-sprite that weaves small patches of the celestial fabric back together wherever the Hollowing has frayed it, arriving at the Crossroads ahead of each constellation relight. art.silhouette: Tiny humanoid woven entirely from luminous thread; body is a loose tangle of glowing filaments in soft cyan, gold and white; legs and arms are thread-loops; a face of two bright white dots in a small thread-loop oval; carries a spool of golden thread on one wrist; whimsical and unique at 16px.
